signal: Seerist powered Bloomberg's company-level geopolitical risk scores, launched AskAnna and DiscoverAI, and reported strong second-half 2025 commercial growth and new-logo acquisition.

email.body1:
Kristen, saw Seerist now powers Bloomberg's geopolitical risk scores and reported strong second-half commercial growth.

Acceleration like that usually means more accounts to capture than the team can cover, especially across commercial and federal motions, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Seerist off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kristen, quick follow-up for Seerist.

With the Bloomberg partnership and new-logo momentum, the capture target probably grew faster than the team can. Most BD leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Seerist needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kristen, last bit of proof for Seerist.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Seerist's reply rate likely compares to peer intelligence and risk teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kristen, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know a high-growth half keeps a BD and capture calendar packed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Seerist's motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
